title: Find the Power of K-Size Subarrays I
summary: Given an array of integers and a positive integer k, determine the power of each subarray of size k.
statement: Given an array of integers and a positive integer k, determine the power of each subarray of size k. The power is the maximum element if the subarray is sorted in ascending order, otherwise, it is -1. Return an array of these powers for all subarrays of size k.
constraints: nums is a nonempty positive-integer array and 1≤k≤len(nums).
A size-k window has power equal to its maximum only when values rise by exactly one at every step; otherwise power is -1.
Return the power for every size-k window in left-to-right order.
hints: A valid window is exactly a suffix of a run whose adjacent values rise by one.
Track the current consecutive-run length while scanning once.
Reset the run on any broken step; for each completed window output its last value iff run≥k.
The run length is the longest valid suffix, so it covers the current size-k window exactly when it reaches k.
editorial: The run length is the longest valid suffix, so it covers the current size-k window exactly when it reaches k.
